coverage.coverageSemantics: GIS coverage counts tiles with real per-layer publication status; biological coverage is the pinned EPA profile maturity declared by the browser. A GIS-complete tile under an UNSUPPORTED profile is not finished national mushroom coverage.

edgeFallbackTiles.note: Zero-normal-state tiles whose real US sample cells resolve one or more pinned US states. The fallback is restricted to tiles the normal 5% rule resolves to zero states and is derived only from actual state geometry at the habitat sample-cell centers; multi-state edge tiles keep every genuine state source.

edgeBlockedTiles.note: Zero-normal-state tiles with no habitat sample cell inside any US state. Their >=1% planner land share is a 1:20M Census cartographic-boundary simplification sliver at the 45/49-degree international border (<=0.019 degrees past the line); building them would publish foreign-only evidence as national coverage. They are explicitly blocked, never silently dropped.
